title: Mutation: a pinned helper set first by logfmt from another field

targets.expr: sum by (msg_name) (count_over_time({stack="tpa"} | logfmt m1="member_name" | json m1="msg", m2="message" | label_format msg_name=`{{ $m := or .m1 .m2 }}{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^[a-z][a-z0-9_ ]{0,59}$" $m "") "" }}{{ $m }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [5m]))
